Commentary.Commentary: Will the Pakistani batsmen come out all guns blazing and will they wither away under pressure? Join us after the innings break to find out! it promises to be an absolutely cracking contest.

It was raining boundaries and sixes and the Pakistani bowlers toiled throughout. The English batsmen fired in unison and bullied the Pakistani bowlers throughout the innings. Hales stole the limelight with his swashbuckling knock and was instrumental in setting the impetus for the English side. He along with Joe Root toiled with the Men in Green and scored runs at will. Root and Hales also stitched together a mammoth third wicket stand of 248 runs. Hales and Root departed trying to up the ante but the damage was already done. Buttler and Morgan had a superb platform to launch from and they did that with absolute authority. They notched together a partnership of 161 runs in just 72 balls and propelled England to 444 runs.

It has been an absolute run-feast at Trent Bridge. It is still unbelievable what we have just witnessed. England reach the highest individual team total in ODI's as they pile up 444/3 on the board. More records were shattered as Alex Hales scored a sensational 171 from 122 balls and that is the highest individual score by an Englishman in ODI cricket. It was an absolute treat to watch! England also scored the most no. of boundaries in a single innings in ODI's.

Fulish delivery outside off, Hales lunges forward and guides it with an angled bat down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Good timing on that one! Straying on the pads, Hales flicks it craftily through square leg and the ball races to the fence!
Back of a length outside off, Root guides it down to third man for a single. He is off the mark!
Good length delivery, Roy camps back and defends it solidly.
Joe Root is the new batsman in.

OUT! Loose from Roy! Shortish delivery, Roy goes for the pull but only manages it to glove it and the ball balloons towards the keeper who is under it and pouches a sitter. First blow for England and Hasan Ali is overwhelmed!
Fullish delivery, Hales drives it through the covers for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Hales glides it down to third man for a single.
Roy works it behind square leg for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Roy! Shortish ball, Roy gets into position early and pulls it to the right of the fielder at short fine leg and the ball whistles away to the boundary!
Good length delivery around middle and leg, Roy camps back and tries to defend but misses and the ball hits him over the thigh pad.
On a length directed at the stumps, Roy defends it hesitantly.
Outside off, Roy pushes it with soft hands and sets off for a single but Amir is quick to it and denies them a single.
Tad full and it is pushed to mid off for a single.
Leg bye! Slants in a length ball on off, it angles in and Hales gets hit on his pads. The appeal for lbw is turned down. A leg bye is taken.
Full ball outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Beautifully done! Length ball outside off, Alex Hales stays deep and plays it through the gap on the covers for a boundary. What a placement on that one.
Length ball on off, Roy tries to push it but the ball goes of an outside edge to backward point for a single.
Full ball outside off, Hales tries to push it but it goes of an inside edge to the fine leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! That's a delightful shot! Back of a length delivery, Roy extends his arms and drives it beautifully through mid off and the ball whistles away to the boundary!
Roy taps it towards point.
On a length directed at the stumps, Hales flicks it beautifull through mid wicket and Riaz runs after it and puts in a good effort. Restricts the batsmen to three runs.
Fulllish delivery, Hales drives it firmly towards mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Hales pushes it towards mid off.
Brilliantly bowled! Tad full on off, Roy pushes it back to Hasan. It falls just short of him.
A good length ball outside off, Roy sees it neatly and leaves it for the keeper.
Fuller ball around the sixth stump line, Hales stays deep and run it through third man for a run.

FOUR! Through the cover fielder! Back of a length ball outside off, Hales gets back and punches it to covers. Babar Azam lets it through for a boundary. It has been a poor effort in the field so far from the tourists. Two misfield boundaries already.
Perfect length ball on middle and leg, Hales off his back foot blocks it neatly.
Length ball on off, pushed to the on side for a brace.
Hasan Ali will bowl from the other end.
Full delivery, Roy drives it straight to the cover region.

FOUR! First boundary of the innings! On a length directed at the stumps, Roy flicks it through square leg. Mohammad Nawaz gives a good chase and fumbles allowing the ball to roll through to the boundary. Poor effort in the end! The timing was not quite there on the shot but he will take it!
Fullish delivery around middle and off, Roy pushes it gently towards mid on.
In the corridor of uncertainity outside off, Roy leaves it alone.
Full delivery just outside off, Roy lunges forward in defence. Watchful start by him!
On a good length around middle and off, Roy prods forward in defence.

The pitch looks like a good batting surface and England will really like to post a good total. Jason Roy and Alex Hales are the two English openers. Mohammad Amir will bowl first up for Pakistan. Here we go...
Team changes - England are unchanged. For Pakistan, Imad Wasim makes way for Mohammad Nawaz.
TOSS - ENGLAND WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT FIRST!

Pakistan's start with the ball has been good but haven't really capitalized when it was needed. Do join us for their electric bout. Will Pakistan make a come back with a win here? Or will it be England all the way with a series win today. Stay tuned, for the toss and other updates.

Pakistan, on the other hand, will surely like to win this match and stay alive in the series. The opening woes continues for them too and apart from Sarfraz Ahmed and his contributions, others have failed to show the stomach for fight. Mohammad Hafeez is ruled out because of his calf injury since 2nd ODI and that is another set back for the tourists.

Hello and a warm welcome for 3rd ODI between England and Pakistan at Trent Bridge. The series is led by the hosts 2-0 and they happen to lead the Super Series 12-8 already. If they win this match, the series will belong to them. The top order looks a bit inconsistent barring Jason Roy with his fireworks. Joe Root is the main man for them as he is a real run-machine for the Englishmen. With return of Ben Stokes it will be an add-on for them along with other quality bowlers.
